class C {

  run(): number {
    let sum: number = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < 10 ; i++) {
      if (i === 2) {
          continue;
      }

      if (i === 5) {
          break;
      }

      sum = sum + i;
    }
    let j: number = 0;
    do {
      sum = sum + 10;
      j++;
    } while (j < 3);
    switch (j) {
      case 3: {
        sum = sum + 100;
        break;
      }
      default: {
        sum = sum + 1;
        break;
      }
    }
    return sum;
  }

}
